inputs.name: Fontaine crystalline category, filtration and unramified descent
inputs.statement: Crystalline representations are stable under subquotients, tensor products and duals; Dcris is exact on admissible objects and DdR is strictly exact. Unramified finite-dimensional representations are crystalline, and chi^a has filtration degree -a.
inputs.source: J.-M. Fontaine, Representations p-adiques semi-stables, Asterisque223(1994),113--184
inputs.scope_match: Actual local rings and cyclotomic actions are identified by BX1--BX2; only finite local fields and E/E[epsilon] are used.

inputs.name: Strong multiplicity one for cuspidal GLn
inputs.statement: Cuspidal representations with identical unramified local parameters outside a finite set are isomorphic. This follows directly from the linear independence theorem for their prime-power traces.
inputs.source: H. Jacquet and J.A. Shalika, On Euler Products and the Classification of Automorphic Forms II, AJM103(1981),777--815
inputs.inspection: Original scanned pages806--807 read directly; nonunitary cuspidal representations are included by the theorem's positive-character normalization.

inputs.name: Normalized Galois attachment for polarized regular algebraic cuspidal representations
inputs.statement: A regular algebraic cuspidal polarized GLn representation over a CM field has a continuous semisimple attached ell-adic representation with normalized local compatibility away from ell and a totally odd polarization. Only these clauses are used.
inputs.source: Barnet-Lamb--Gee--Geraghty--Taylor, Potential automorphy and change of weight, Annals179(2014),501--609
inputs.scope_match: Geometric Frobenius eigenvalues q^((n-1)/2) times Satake; Hecke avatar on G_K is theta*chi^(n-1). Infinity sign is corrected by the quadratic character without changing restriction to G_K.

inputs.name: Chebotarev density
inputs.statement: Every conjugacy class in a finite Galois quotient occurs as Frobenius outside any given finite set. Thus cofinite Frobenius characteristic-polynomial agreement gives equality of continuous traces; the semisimple character criterion is proved in RX5.
inputs.source: J.S. Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, version3.08(2020)

inputs.name: Thorne irreducible automorphic adjoint Selmer vanishing
inputs.statement: For CM F, n>=2 and regular algebraic cuspidal polarized pi, irreducibility of r_pi on G_{F(mu_ell^infty)} implies H1_f(Fplus,ad r_pi)=0, for the polarized unitary adjoint. No residual-image or enormousness hypothesis is imposed.
inputs.source: J.A. Thorne, On the vanishing of adjoint Bloch--Kato Selmer groups of irreducible automorphic Galois representations, PAMQ18(2022),no.5
inputs.scope_match: F=the original embedded imaginary quadratic K, Fplus=Q, n=4. RX4 proves the exact infinite cyclotomic irreducibility. RX5 identifies the negative-transpose polarized adjoint, and RX3/BX identify the local finite conditions.
